Package org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp

Class McpAuthInterceptor

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.McpAuthInterceptor
All Implemented Interfaces:
RestCallInterceptor
public class McpAuthInterceptor extends Object implements RestCallInterceptor
A builder-configurable auth-token seam implemented as a RestCallInterceptor.

On onInit(RestRequest), sets the Authorization request header to "Bearer " + token, where token comes from a caller-supplied Supplier. Sub-project F's OAuth/OIDC flows plug into this seam by supplying their own token-supplier implementation (e.g. one that refreshes an expired access token); this class implements no OAuth/OIDC flow itself.

If the supplied token is null or blank (empty or all-whitespace), no Authorization header is set for that request (the call proceeds unauthenticated) - a blank token is never sent as a credential-less Authorization: Bearer header. If the token supplier itself throws, RestRequest.run()'s documented interceptor-exception handling aborts the call before it is sent.

Note: when a token is set, RestRequest.debug() logs the full outgoing request including all headers, so enabling debug logging on a client using this interceptor will log the Authorization header (and therefore the bearer token) in plain text.

Since:
10.0.0
